performance.verdict: Spend is live but 28-day leads read zero — attribution is broken, not demand.

findings.text: 28-day leads field reads 0 despite 15 Google Ads conversions and 39 GBP calls — CRM/pixel attribution is broken, CPL is incalculable.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completion event; with intake seat vacant since 7/7, speed-to-lead automation is unverified.
GHL shows 44 opportunities created but 0 appointments and $0 pipeline value — 38 opps are sitting without a booking step, pointing to an intake process leak.

3-day spend signal (Aug 16–18: $9.12, $18.71, $16.06) is sharply below prior 3 days ($130.18 avg); erratic daily spend pattern across 45 days suggests budget pacing or manual pauses, not a campaign failure.
GBP actions dropped 25% week-over-week (8 actions on Aug 16, then 0 on Aug 17–18) — likely Windsor data lag per SOW caveat, not confirmed demand loss.

suggestions.text: Audit lead attribution pipeline: reconcile 15 Google Ads conversions and 39 GBP calls against GHL contacts to locate the zero-leads gap.
suggestions.monday_update: The 28-day leads field reads 0 while Google Ads logged 15 conversions and GBP logged 39 calls — these contacts are not reaching GHL as trackable leads. Pull the GHL contact log, cross-reference call timestamps with Google Ads and GBP call logs, and identify where the handoff breaks. Success is confirmed when GHL opportunities reflect the 15 conversions already registered in Google Ads. Complete audit by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Confirm booking bot is live and tested; verify who owns the GHL intake seat vacated on 7/7 before any budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: The booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 with no completion on record, and the dispatch seat (Vivian) has been vacant since 7/7. Confirm with Xavier or Aiman who currently owns GHL intake and after-hours coverage, and run the bot battle-test against a live inbound call or form submission. Success is a named owner in GHL with a verified automation trigger firing. The scale-back-up gate in the SOW explicitly blocks budget raises until this is resolved — complete by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Watch erratic Google Ads daily pacing; re-check 3-day spend signal on 2026-08-22 before adjusting budgets.
suggestions.monday_update: Daily Google spend has been highly erratic — ranging from $0 to $248.50 within the same 45-day window, with the last 3 days averaging ~$14.63 vs a prior-3-day average of ~$130. Do not adjust budgets until the attribution fix (S1) and intake gate (S2) are resolved. Re-check the 3-day spend signal on 2026-08-22; if spend remains below $30/day without a manual pause in place, escalate to Nacer for account-level review.
